semantic_readbacks.topic: Root, inherited layouts and mode redirect
semantic_readbacks.detail: Root page unconditionally redirects to /dashboard. /screener redirects to shared Step 1. Legacy Step 5 redirects to stocks Step 4. ScreenerStepGate reads hydrated persisted mode before allowing slugs; mismatched slugs route to active mode index 4, failed hydration grace routes to Step 1. Do not treat source slug digit as logical Stocks step index.

Root layout mounts hydration/theme/min-width globally. Frame wraps children and parallel contextRail with TopBar, ConfigHealthBanner, NavRail, InitStores and shortcuts. ContextRail renders supplied children; rail pages/defaults are not independent URL pages. Standalone chart inherits root layout but has a pass-through standalone layout rather than Frame. Slot retained content versus defaults is runtime/history dependent.

dev/components explicitly calls notFound outside development; development renders atom/molecule gallery including statuses/theme. __test-crash also checks NODE_ENV then throws, but leading underscore is Next private-folder convention: source page existence does not establish routable /__test-crash. Runtime/Next route manifest must resolve exposure. Neither source entry silently excluded.

evidence.note: private source crash function and production notFound guard

semantic_readbacks.detail: Actual source uses 1280px minimum by default and 1200px only on exact Step 7 trade-card/position-card paths. The overlay keeps children mounted. semantic_readbacks.topic: Settings nine sections and nested state
semantic_readbacks.detail: SECTIONS has exactly nine keys and initial active section is brokers. JSX branches dispatch local form components; scan has nested spreads, gates and scheduled controls; tuning has ProposalCard.expanded fold evidence. Credential/notification/job controls are source inventory only and must use synthetic inputs with network mutations blocked. Settings sections own explicit domain handoffs, not one blanket settings correctness claim.

semantic_readbacks.topic: Persistence overlay is part of restoration
semantic_readbacks.detail: StoreHydration starts explicit store rehydrations, then conditional last-scan recovery and metadata fetches. Options context reconstruction precedes recovered result insertion under guarded conditions. InitStores independently rehydrates portfolio/watchlist then syncs backend data. Browser reload probes must record both storage and mock recovery responses; seeding localStorage alone does not define final state. These mechanisms are read for discovery only, not independently audited correctness.

evidence.note: rehydrate, last scan recovery and guarded context

semantic_readbacks.detail: NavItems has eleven primary destinations (Validation is still a source route without a primary nav entry). NavRail substitutes Stepper when pathname starts /screener. StepNavBar has a REJECT-regime confirmation dialog; modal presence suppresses arrow shortcuts. Runtime must test buttons, direct URLs, keyboard navigation and back/forward under each mode.

Watchlist has stocks/contracts tabs and selected-symbol InlineChartPanel. Portfolio has open/history, per-contract EditDrawer, close error and ClosePositionDrawer overlays plus clear confirmation. Alerts selects alerts/rules/watches and new/edit/duplicate rule builder. Journal toggles create/edit form and deletion ConfirmDialog. Calendar has month navigation and day selection; strategy-watch has single and bulk subscription controls. Their custom child calls and native conditions are retained in definition records, with all actual mutation paths mocked/blocked by runtime task.

semantic_readbacks.topic: CSS tooltips, portal placement and imperative charts
semantic_readbacks.detail: Tooltip renders a role=tooltip span; CSS hides it with display:none and exposes it for wrap:hover and focus-within. Source occurrence IDs cover this actual CSS trigger. TradeCard portals methodSelector into decisionTarget, with inline fallback when target is undefined and hidden when null; selector JSX remains in TradeCard source. ChartPane/CandlestickChart instantiate lightweight-charts imperatively. ChartWorkspace subscribes click/crosshair and Escape drawing behavior. Explicit manual surface IDs preserve these non-JSX/placement requirements. A repository-wide source search found no other createPortal callsite or onContextMenu/contextmenu handler in app/components; that search does not certify third-party chart menus or all CSS semantic disclosures.

evidence.note: imperative chart creation and crosshair subscription

pending_discovery.detail: Module closure includes all reachable imports/re-exports and co-located JSX functions; symbol-level use and condition feasibility require reconciliation. No claim that every candidate renders on every associated route.

AST map callsites enumerate repeated source definitions, not each data-dependent row, tab option, chart series or nested tree node. Runtime must attach fixture row/node identity and parent conditions; no finite production instance count claimed.

Native role/title/details and class hints plus custom JSX calls discover candidates, not proof of semantic disclosure exhaustiveness. Manually reconcile CSS hover/focus tooltips, DOM portals, imperative charts/context menus, non-JSX render factories and dynamically chosen component registries.

Nine-state template is conservatively pending for all instances. Domain lanes B-I must split zero/false/null/absent and cancel/error scenarios, provide fixtures and source-backed N/A where appropriate; no universal fixture or state pass claimed.

Each primary route has applicable exact slot page or nearest default in roots. Soft navigation may retain earlier slot content; Task 2 must map retained instances to their source entry instead of treating current URL closure as exhaustive history.
Resolve private underscore source against actual Next route manifest and dev/prod response; do not claim Frame error-boundary coverage from this source.
No backend run/restart performed in source task. Recovery mock plus browser reload coverage is not a real database/process restart certification.

Definition owners use domain/path defaults and explicit Settings section handoff. Reused chart/report/portfolio widgets can require multiple numeric lanes in route context; owning lanes must confirm interactions and do not infer one owner is sole arithmetic authority.
